Beyond the gates of SpinWinter Casino lies a northern kingdom of gaming entertainment, complete with its own tournaments, treasury of rewards and system of VIP ranks. We bring together over 10,000 games, sports betting, tournaments and jackpots with a prize pool of up to €1,000,000. At the heart of our kingdom is the Premium Shop, where accumulated Chips can be exchanged for digital and physical rewards.

At SpinWinter, every player chooses their own path, from discovering classic slots to taking part in tournaments. Four welcome packages, five-day challenges and a multi-tier VIP Club complement our gaming collection. Explore our entertainment options and discover the features of our northern kingdom at your own pace.

SpinWinter Welcome Bonuses

To begin your story at SpinWinter Casino, we have created four welcome packages. Each comes with its own reward value, number of qualifying deposits and conditions of use.

The Casino Welcome Pack includes 550% up to €12,100, 550 Free Spins on Gold Rush - Johnny Cash and 300,000 Chips. The rewards are spread across your first five deposits.

The VIP Welcome Pack provides a combined 800% across your first four deposits, along with an additional 300,000 Chips. Higher minimum deposit requirements apply to this package.

The Crypto Welcome Pack includes 620% up to 14,500 USDT and 620 Free Spins on Bonanza Trillion. The offer covers your first five qualifying deposits.

The Sport Welcome Pack includes 150% in FreeBets for selected football competitions. Specific odds requirements and bet slip conditions apply to these sports rewards.

Once you have completed your welcome package at SpinWinter, Weekly Reloads become available. The programme includes eight weekly offers with bonuses of up to 100% and individual rewards worth up to €700. Activation, wagering and reward conditions are available alongside our bonuses and regular promotions.

Gaming Lobby From Classic Slots to Live Tables

More than 100 game developers contribute to the diverse gaming collection at SpinWinter Casino. We have organised their titles into dedicated categories, including Top, New, Trending Games and Bonus Wager, alongside a game search and provider filters. Discover familiar gaming formats and new mechanics with their own distinctive features.

Slots and Table Games

Our Slots category combines classic machines with fixed paylines and modern video slots featuring cascading wins, multipliers and themed bonus rounds. Game settings take you through ancient civilisations, fantasy worlds and legendary eras. SpinWinter also features Megaways slots, where the number of possible winning combinations changes with each spin.

Among our popular titles, Wanted Dead or a Wild by Hacksaw Gaming features special symbols and multipliers during its bonus rounds. Lion Gems 3 Pots uses the Hold and Win mechanic, built around collecting prize symbols. Elephant's Gold complements the selection with its own Bonus Combo feature.

We regularly update our New category with traditional reel-based slots and alternative gaming formats. Bingo Empire, for example, incorporates bingo mechanics, while Mines Football combines a football theme with the selection of individual gaming positions.

For fans of traditional table games, we offer digital versions of roulette, blackjack and poker. These games use random number generators to determine their outcomes, with rounds taking place without a live dealer.

Live Casino and Game Shows

Our Live Casino is like a separate hall within our kingdom, where real dealers host games at the tables. We have brought together over 300 games streamed from dedicated gaming studios. SpinWinter Casino features traditional, fast-paced and specialised live games with different rules and betting limits.

The Roulette category includes classic tables, automated wheels and variations with additional multipliers. Venice Roulette features a live studio broadcast, while Auto Roulette uses an automated wheel. Gravity Roulette adds its own bonus mechanics to the traditional rules.

Our Blackjack category includes tables with different round speeds and betting limits. Speed Blackjack offers a faster-paced format, while Monaco Blackjack VIP belongs to our selection of dedicated VIP tables.

For alternative entertainment, SpinWinter features a dedicated Game Shows category. Adventures Beyond Wonderland Live combines a themed prize wheel with additional rounds, while Wheel of Fortune uses wheel segments with different outcomes. Our live collection also includes baccarat, Sic Bo and Dragon Tiger.

Bonus Wager Games

We have created a dedicated Bonus Wager collection featuring games that can contribute towards bonus wagering requirements. The selection includes Snoop Dogg Dollars by BGaming, while The Great Icescape features cascading wins. Each game's wagering contribution depends on the conditions of the active promotion.

Tournament Arena and Major Jackpots

The SpinWinter Casino tournament arena brings together network tournaments, regular races and promotions featuring randomly awarded cash prizes. Each event has its own rules, prize pool and selection of participating slots. Competition formats differ in how winners are determined and rewards are distributed.

  • Lucky Boom - a total prize pool of €600,000, divided into stages worth €30,000 each. Cash prizes may be awarded randomly during spins that meet the promotion's requirements.
  • Big Sunday Blast - a weekly Sunday event featuring a €25,000 prize pool and a dedicated collection of participating slots.
  • VIP Weekly - regular tournament competitions with their own prize pool and participation requirements.
  • Multi Race - tournament races with a dedicated scoring system.

We have created dedicated game collections for Lucky Boom and Big Sunday Blast. These promotions feature eligible slots from Playson and Booongo. Participation requirements and prize distribution are determined by the rules of each competition.

Jackpots form a separate treasury within SpinWinter. We feature fixed jackpots with predetermined prize amounts and progressive jackpots that grow through qualifying bets. Once a progressive jackpot is won, the prize pool resets and begins accumulating again.

Premium Shop and the Treasury of Rewards

The Premium Shop at SpinWinter Casino is our treasury of digital and physical prizes, with its own reward currency known as Chips. These are earned through deposits and eligible slot bets. Your Chips are stored separately from your main cash balance.

Every €1 deposited earns 50 Chips. Eligible slot bets award 20 Chips for every €0.20 wagered. Accumulated Chips can be exchanged for items from the available shop collection.

The SpinWinter treasury includes several reward categories:

  • Free Spins - packages of free spins for slot games.
  • Real Money and Bonus Money - cash and bonus funds subject to their respective conditions.
  • Mystery Cases - Silver, Gold and Premium Cases containing hidden rewards.
  • Gift Cards - vouchers for Amazon, Steam, Uber, Apple, Decathlon, Starbucks and other brands.
  • Premium Items - physical rewards, including the Land Rover Defender.

Every reward has its own price in Chips and conditions for redemption. We update our shop collection and introduce special offers. You can view your accumulated Chips and available rewards when you log in to your account.

The Five-Day WinStreak Quest

WinStreak is a separate challenge within the kingdom of SpinWinter Casino, built around a series of gaming tasks. The quest runs over five days, with specific rules governing each stage. A final reward is available upon completion of all required tasks in accordance with the promotion's conditions.

Unlike SpinWinter tournaments, this feature focuses on your individual progress through the challenge. A dedicated section of your account displays your current progress, available tasks and the value of the final reward.

Wheel of Gods Zeus and Hades

Ancient legends come to life in Wheel of Gods, a dedicated SpinWinter Casino mini-game featuring two prize wheels. Zeus and Hades have their own access requirements. Once the initial deposit requirement has been met, one free spin on the Zeus Wheel becomes available each day, while an additional spin on the Hades Wheel requires payment.

Each wheel contains eight segments, with outcomes determined randomly. Possible rewards include up to €435 in bonus funds and packages ranging from 5 to 100 Free Spins. Unused free wheel spins do not accumulate, and awarded prizes are subject to their own wagering and conversion requirements.

SpinWinter Casino VIP Club From Bronze to Obsidian

Our northern kingdom has its own hierarchy of VIP ranks. The programme consists of 17 levels across five categories - Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Obsidian. Progress is measured through Gems earned from deposits and Stars awarded for eligible gaming activity. Your achieved status is not downgraded solely because of inactivity.

Daily cashback at SpinWinter can reach 40%, while rakeback can reach 60%. Cashback is calculated from eligible gaming losses, whereas rakeback depends on gaming turnover and the house edge. The maximum amount returned under the programme's conditions is €10,000.

Level-Up Rewards include up to €5,000 and 200 Free Spins. At eligible levels, members can access a personal VIP manager, individual bonus offers, exclusive tournaments and higher withdrawal limits. Each VIP rank has its own set of privileges, which can be viewed in your account.

Sports Betting and Esports

Beyond the gaming halls of SpinWinter Casino, our sportsbook covers international championships, domestic leagues and individual sporting competitions. We focus on football, cricket and tennis, alongside basketball, ice hockey, boxing and other disciplines.

Our football coverage includes the English Premier League and domestic championships in Spain, Italy, Germany and France. European club competitions and international fixtures involving national teams are also available. Depending on the event, betting markets include match results, totals, handicaps and other outcomes.

SpinWinter features two main betting formats - Pre-Match and Live Betting. Pre-match markets cover upcoming fixtures, while live betting displays available markets and changing odds as events unfold. Accumulator bets can combine multiple events, and dedicated categories cover outright betting markets.

We have created a separate esports section featuring Counter-Strike 2, Valorant and Dota 2 competitions. Virtual eFootball matches are also available in our sportsbook. The gaming lobby and sports betting section share a single account and balance.

Depositing Funds

The SpinWinter Casino cashier supports debit cards, mobile payment services and cryptocurrency transactions. We operate a multi-currency account system that includes EUR and GBP. Available payment options depend on your country of residence, account currency and the conditions of the respective payment service.

The standard minimum deposit in euros is €20. Separate minimum deposit requirements may apply to bonus offers. We do not charge our own deposit processing fees, although banks and third-party payment services may apply additional charges.

The SpinWinter cryptocurrency cashier supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Solana, Bitcoin Cash, Dogecoin and Tron. Stablecoin transactions are also available through USDT on the TRC-20 and ERC-20 networks, alongside USDC. When transferring funds, the blockchain network must match the payment address network specified in the cashier.

Withdrawals and Payout Limits

Withdrawal requests at SpinWinter Casino are submitted through your account cashier. The minimum withdrawal in euros is €50, while maximum limits depend on your selected payment method. Individual card withdrawals can reach €3,000, while cryptocurrency transactions can reach €10,000.

Before requesting a withdrawal, deposited funds must be wagered once (x1) in accordance with our financial rules. If active bonus funds remain in your account, separate wagering requirements apply. Requesting a withdrawal before completing the bonus conditions may result in the cancellation of the reward and associated winnings.

We process withdrawal requests within three working days in accordance with our general terms and conditions. Subsequent settlement follows the processing procedures of the relevant payment service. You can view the status of your financial transactions in your account history.

At SpinWinter, deposits and withdrawals must be made using payment details belonging to the account holder. Before completing a financial transaction, we may request proof of ownership of the relevant bank account, card or cryptocurrency wallet.

Financial Security and Verification

To protect personal information at SpinWinter Casino, we use SSL encryption and financial transaction monitoring procedures. Identity verification is carried out before withdrawals, when cumulative deposits reach €2,000 or when suspicious activity is detected.

Our Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures may require a passport, national identity card or driving licence. Where necessary, we may request a selfie with your identification document and proof of residential address. Proof of address must have been issued within the previous three months.

For deposits exceeding €5,000, SpinWinter may require additional Source of Funds verification. These procedures help us establish ownership of payment methods, prevent unauthorised transactions and maintain compliance with our financial rules.

SpinWinter Casino Mobile Experience

We have made our gaming kingdom accessible from smartphones as well as computers. Our website is adapted for Android and iOS devices and runs directly through a web browser. There is no need to download APK files or install a separate application.

Our mobile collection includes over 9,800 games, covering video slots, table games and live dealer broadcasts. The gaming interface adapts to your device's screen size. Individual game availability depends on the technical capabilities of your smartphone and browser.

The SpinWinter mobile website also provides access to sports betting, the Premium Shop, tournaments and the cashier. Active rewards, transaction history and account settings are available without switching to the desktop website.

We use a single account across computers and smartphones. Your main balance, accumulated Chips, WinStreak progress and current VIP status are retained when switching devices. You do not need to create an additional account for mobile access.

24/7 Customer Support

Our SpinWinter Casino customer support team is available around the clock through Live Chat. We assist with account access, document verification, financial transactions and bonus conditions.

Our chat service also provides information about tournament rules, Premium Shop mechanics and individual gaming features. When investigating financial enquiries, we may request additional information about the relevant transaction.

Responsible Gambling

At SpinWinter, we treat gambling exclusively as a form of entertainment for adults aged 18 and over. Gambling outcomes are uncertain, and bonuses, cashback and other rewards do not guarantee profits or the recovery of money spent.

We provide options for setting financial limits and requesting voluntary self-exclusion. Account access restrictions can be arranged through our customer support team. During self-exclusion, gambling activity, deposits and participation in promotions are blocked. Stay within your personal budget and never use gambling as a way to recover financial losses.

Claim up to 400% and 400 free spins with our Casino Welcome Pack, or choose the VIP Welcome Pack with deposit bonuses of up to 500%. CaratLuck Casino also has a dedicated cryptocurrency package with 490 free spins and additional deposit rewards.

Once your welcome offers are complete, there are eight Reload offers every week, the Early Payout sports promotion and tournaments with cash prizes to enjoy. Our CaratLuck Casino bonus selection gives you different ways to receive rewards, whether you prefer slots, cryptocurrency deposits or sports betting.

Casino Welcome Pack

Your first five deposits give you access to the CaratLuck Casino bonus Welcome Pack, offering up to 400% worth €29,000 and 400 free spins in total. We've divided the welcome package into several stages, so you can collect new rewards with your initial deposits. Each stage has its own bonus percentage, maximum bonus amount and number of free spins.

Free spins complement your deposit bonuses, allowing you to play selected slots without paying separately for each spin. Gold Rush with Johnny Cash is among the games included in the welcome offer. Your CaratLuck bonus funds are credited to a separate balance, while access to the next stage depends on meeting the conditions of the relevant promotion.

To claim your CaratLuck Casino bonus, create a personal account, select the Casino Welcome Pack and make a deposit that meets the requirements of the current stage. If you're already registered, you can log in to your account and activate an available offer. Before you deposit, we'll display the bonus conditions, including the minimum deposit and maximum reward.

The Casino Welcome Pack comes with the following conditions:

  • The package is available to new players on their first five real-money deposits.

  • Bonus funds have a wagering requirement of x40 the bonus amount received.

  • Winnings from free spins are also subject to x40 wagering.

  • You have 7 days to complete wagering after activating the bonus or receiving your free spin winnings, respectively.

  • The maximum bet with an active bonus is €5.

  • Maximum winnings from free spins are capped at €1,000.

  • Withdrawals of deposit bonus winnings are limited to 10x the bonus received, while free spin winnings have a withdrawal limit of 2x the amount won.

For example, a €100 CaratLuck bonus with x40 wagering requires qualifying bets totalling €4,000. Once wagering is complete, the maximum withdrawal limit for winnings from that deposit bonus is €1,000. This limit does not guarantee a payout of that amount, as your actual winnings depend on the outcome of your games.

We allow only one active bonus at a time. If you request a withdrawal before completing the bonus conditions or while the bonus is still active, any unused bonus funds and associated winnings will be forfeited. You can also cancel a bonus through your account or contact our support team, but doing so will result in the loss of the bonus funds and related winnings.

Winnings from the CaratLuck Casino bonus Welcome Pack become eligible for withdrawal once you've met the wagering requirements and successfully completed identity verification. All payouts are subject to our standard KYC and AML procedures.

VIP Welcome Pack

The CaratLuck Casino bonus VIP Welcome Pack gives you access to larger deposit bonuses totalling up to 500%, with a maximum combined value of €29,000. We've created this package for your first four real-money deposits. Each stage provides an additional bonus based on its specified percentage and maximum reward amount.

This offer is also known as the VIP High Roller Package. Unlike the standard Casino Welcome Pack, it focuses on deposit bonuses without additional free spins. Each of the four stages has its own minimum deposit requirement and maximum bonus amount.

You must activate your CaratLuck bonus from the VIP package within seven days of it being awarded. Once activated, a separate seven-day wagering period begins. The wagering requirement is x40 the bonus amount, and the maximum permitted bet while using the bonus is €5.

The withdrawal limit depends on which of the four VIP bonuses you've activated:

For example, if your first VIP bonus is €200, the maximum withdrawal of winnings from that bonus is €600. For a bonus of the same value on the second, third or fourth stage, the limit increases to €1,000. These limits apply after you've completed wagering and do not represent guaranteed winnings.

The VIP Welcome Pack operates separately from our loyalty programme. After using your welcome offers, you can continue progressing through the Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Obsidian levels at CaratLuck Casino. Our VIP Club includes level-up bonuses, daily cashback, Live Casino rakeback and additional benefits for members at higher tiers.

If you cancel a VIP bonus or request a withdrawal before completing its conditions, the bonus funds and any associated winnings will be forfeited. Winnings from this package are also subject to standard KYC verification before payment.

CaratLuck Sport Bonus

Our CaratLuck Casino bonus selection extends to sports betting through Early Payout, a special promotion for football matches. It allows your bet on a team to win to be settled as a winner before the final whistle. Your selected team simply needs to take a lead of at least two goals at any point during normal time.

Early Payout applies to selected football fixtures marked with the relevant promotion label. To qualify, you must place a pre-match bet on either the home or away team to win in the main 1X2 market. Bets on a draw and bets placed after kick-off are not eligible for this promotion.

For example, suppose you back a team to win and they take a 2-0 lead during the match. We'll settle your bet as a winner under the Early Payout rules. Even if the opposition later equalises or goes on to win, the result of your already settled bet will remain unchanged.

Early Payout is available on selected matches in the Premier League, La Liga, Ligue 1, Bundesliga, Serie A and UEFA Conference League. We may update the list of eligible competitions, so a fixture only qualifies when the Early Payout label appears in our sportsbook.

If a match is postponed, cancelled or requires a result review, our general sports betting settlement rules apply. The promotion does not change how bets that fail to meet its conditions are settled. We may restrict participation or cancel the relevant promotional benefit if the rules are breached.

CaratLuck Crypto Welcome Pack

The CaratLuck Casino bonus package for cryptocurrency deposits combines up to 490% in deposit rewards with 490 free spins. The Crypto Welcome Pack has a maximum value of 16,900 USDT. It covers the first five qualifying deposits made by new players, with additional funds and free spins awarded according to the conditions of each stage.

To activate the offer, choose a cryptocurrency payment method and make the minimum deposit required for the relevant bonus. We support Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron and Tether. Available deposit methods and networks are displayed in the cashier, where you can also check the payment details before making a transfer.

Free spins are credited automatically after a qualifying deposit. Each spin has a value of €0.10, and maximum winnings from free spins are capped at €1,000. The number of free spins awarded depends on the relevant stage of the welcome package.

The Crypto Welcome Pack has an x40 wagering requirement for both deposit bonuses and free spin winnings. Your CaratLuck bonus funds must be wagered within seven days of activation, while free spin winnings must be wagered within seven days of being credited. The maximum bet while using an active bonus is €5.

Withdrawals of winnings from a crypto deposit bonus are limited to 10x the bonus amount received. If you request a payout before completing wagering, the active bonus and any associated winnings will be forfeited. The same applies if you voluntarily cancel the bonus through your account or our support team.

Cryptocurrency rewards under our CaratLuck bonus offers are subject to KYC and additional AML checks, which may include verification of the source of funds before payment.

After the welcome packages, we continue rewarding players with eight Reload offers every week. These provide opportunities to claim new deposit bonuses under the conditions of the current promotions. The availability of each Reload bonus depends on your account, and only one bonus offer can be active at a time.

All CaratLuck Casino bonus welcome packages follow the same financial verification rules. You must complete KYC before withdrawing bonus winnings, while cryptocurrency transactions may require additional documents confirming the source of funds. Deposits exceeding €5,000 are subject to Source of Wealth checks. Withdrawals are made using the same payment method as the initial deposit, in accordance with our AML rules.

Jackpots

Explore CaratLuck jackpot slots with a prize pool of up to €1,000,000. Our Jackpot category brings together games with special prize mechanics, additional features and opportunities for substantial wins. Each slot has its own jackpot rules and bonus round features.

Available games include Ozwin's Jackpots, Jackpot Raiders, 777 Jackpot Diamond Hold and Win and Super Fire Jackpot. You can also try Ocean King Jackpot, Frost Queen Jackpots and Jackpot Joker. Some slots use Hold and Win mechanics, while others feature their own ways of triggering special prizes.

Jackpot amounts depend on the game, its mechanics and the provider's rules. In some slots, prizes may be fixed or change during gameplay. The advertised maximum of €1,000,000 does not guarantee a win of that amount, and certain jackpot draws may have additional minimum bet requirements.

Jackpot winnings are different from deposit bonuses. If you're playing with an active bonus balance, access to certain games and their contribution towards wagering depend on the conditions of the relevant promotion. Regular game rules apply when playing with real-money funds.

Tournaments

CaratLuck Casino hosts tournament promotions for Playson and Booongo slots, with cash prizes available to participants. Lucky Boom has a total prize pool of €600,000, while Big Sunday Blast offers a share of €25,000 every Sunday. Both promotions have their own schedules, betting requirements and prize rules.

At CaratLuck, Lucky Boom runs from 21 September 2026 to 7 February 2027. The total prize pool is €600,000, with €30,000 allocated to each stage. Participants can receive random cash prizes while playing selected Playson and Booongo slots.

To qualify, you must complete at least 100 spins with a minimum bet of €0.50. Each qualifying spin gives you a chance to receive a random prize from the available pool. You can win multiple rewards during the promotion while prizes remain available. Unclaimed prizes expire 90 days after being awarded, and technical malfunctions affecting the outcome may result in payouts being voided.

Big Sunday Blast takes place every Sunday from 02:00 to 23:59 UTC between 7 June 2026 and 7 March 2027. The weekly prize pool is €25,000. All Playson and Booongo slots are eligible, and players must meet the minimum bet and spin requirements to qualify.

Only real-money bets count towards Big Sunday Blast. The minimum bet is €0.50, and you must complete at least 100 spins to qualify. Prizes are credited automatically or after the relevant tournament stage has ended.

pages.title: Login
pages.content:
Log in to CaratLuck Casino and pick up where you left off with your existing balance, favourite slots and active rewards. The CaratLuck Casino login gives you access to your personal settings and transaction history, so everything you need remains available whenever you sign in.

To log in to CaratLuck, enter the email address and password you used when registering. Your CaratLuck Casino login details are linked to your personal account, while our security measures help protect your information and monitor suspicious activity. If you encounter difficulties with your CaratLuck login, we'll help you regain access.

How to Log In and Complete Verification

The CaratLuck Casino login process takes just a few simple steps. Click the Login button in the top menu, enter your account details and return to your personal dashboard. There, you can check your balance, transaction history, active bonuses and profile settings. Your CaratLuck account keeps this information together, so you can return to it whenever you sign in.

To complete your CaratLuck login, follow these steps:

  1. Click the Login button at the top of the page.

  2. Enter the email address you used during registration.

  3. Enter your account password.

  4. Click Login to complete the sign-in process.

A successful CaratLuck Casino login does not automatically complete identity verification. Your email address and password are sufficient for standard access, while Know Your Customer (KYC) checks help us confirm that the account belongs to you. Additional verification may be required before certain financial transactions, even if you've previously signed in without any issues.

Full KYC verification is mandatory when you request a withdrawal, when your cumulative deposits exceed €2,000 or if we detect suspicious activity. Your CaratLuck login remains separate from these financial checks. Depending on your payment method, country of residence and the nature of your transactions, we may request documents earlier, regardless of how much you've deposited.

To verify your identity, we may ask for:

  • A valid passport, national identity card or driving licence.

  • A selfie holding your identification document.

  • A bank statement, utility bill or other proof of address issued within the last three months.

  • Additional documents relating to your payment method or source of funds if required for verification.

For deposits exceeding €5,000, we apply Source of Wealth checks. These involve confirming the legitimate origin of your funds through documents relating to employment income, business earnings, investments or other sources of income. CaratLuck may also require additional checks for cryptocurrency transactions under our AML Policy.

During verification, we use different levels of checks, including SDD, CDD and EDD, depending on our risk assessment. If the documents provided are insufficient or the information doesn't match your account details, we may request further evidence. Certain financial features may remain restricted until the required checks are complete. You can still complete a standard CaratLuck Casino login unless access to your account has been restricted for security reasons. Once verification is successful, we'll confirm your account's verification status.

Security Standards and Account Monitoring

We protect every CaratLuck Casino login through technical and organisational security measures. When you access CaratLuck Casino, we monitor financial transactions and unusual activity to help prevent unauthorised access and fraud.

An unfamiliar CaratLuck Casino login attempt, unusual transaction or inconsistency in personal information may trigger additional security checks. In such cases, we may temporarily restrict access to certain features until we've verified the account holder's identity. If documents are required, our team will explain what information you need to provide.

To protect financial transactions, we check that payment methods match the account holder's details. Bank cards, e-wallets and other payment methods must belong to the person registered on the account. Under our AML Policy, withdrawals must be made using the same payment method used for the initial deposit.

We use your personal information to manage your account, verify your identity, process transactions and meet applicable requirements. We do not sell personal information to third parties. However, certain details may be shared with payment partners, authorised service providers or relevant authorities where permitted or required by our policies.

Keep your CaratLuck login details private by using a unique password and never sharing it with anyone else. If you sign in on a shared device or someone else's computer, make sure you log out when you've finished. Avoid saving passwords in publicly accessible browsers, and never disclose confidential account information to other people.

If you notice unfamiliar transactions, changes to your settings or activity you don't recognise, contact our support team. We'll investigate the circumstances and, if necessary, request identity verification or temporarily restrict access to protect your information and funds. CaratLuck support can also assist if you suspect someone else has gained access to your account.
